newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fairform offers 57 mln shrs at HK$1.08 each in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Fairform offers 57 mln shrs at HK$1.08 each in IPO.

text.p: Hong Kong-based household and bathroom products maker Fairform Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it would issue 57 million new shares, or 25 percent of its enlarged share capital, at HK$1.08 each in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong.

The issue price represents a prospective price to earnings multiple of 6.83 times on a fully-diluted basis and 6.20 times on a weighted average basis. The prospective dividend yield is 7.6 percent, and net tangible asset value per share is HK$0.50.
The IPO will run from June 13 to 18 and dealing in the shares is expected to begin on June 25.
Lippo Securities Ltd is the sponsor of the issue.

Fairform is involved in the design, development, manufacture and sale of over 300 different electric personal care and healthcare products, and bathroom accessories. The company's products are mainly for export to Europe and the United States.
It also makes and sells metal parts and plastic tooling, and provides casing metallisation services.
Fairform said net proceeds of about HK$50 million would be used for construction of production facilities in China, to develop new products and for working capital.
The company forecast profit after taxation and minority interest but before extraordinary items of not less than HK$35 million for the year ending in December 1997.

It posted profit of HK$27.16 million for the year ended in December 1996, up from HK$24.28 million in 1995 and HK$18.97 million in 1994. Turnover was HK$310.23 million in 1996, against HK$218.66 million in 1995 and HK$141.90 million in 1994.
